# Himalayan Koh

> Himalayan Koh is a premier importer and distributor of authentic, unrefined Himalayan Pink Salt sourced directly from ancient geologic seams in Khewra, Pakistan, and distributed from Houston, Texas.

## Primary Offerings

- **Livestock Salt Licks**: 100% natural solid rock salt blocks on rope and loose blocks (2 lb, 6 lb, 30 lb, 45 lb) supplying vital dietary sodium and chloride electrolytes for horses, cattle, goats, and pasture livestock.
- **Edible Himalayan Pink Salt**: Pure, food-grade unrefined pink mineral salt in fine, medium, and coarse grain sizes for gourmet culinary seasoning, finishing, and food preparation.
- **Wholesale & B2B Supply**: Full case packaging, pallet shipments, and tailored commercial supply contracts for agricultural retailers, equestrian centers, ranch supply stores, and gourmet food distributors.
